adaptations: Explicit user-supplied input paths replace private repository defaults.

Only required Ridge helpers and BT fitter are extracted.
Replay accepts ordered JSON records instead of opening a production database.
Project-specific case alias mapping is omitted; callers normalize their own identifiers.
archived_backends: Configuration grids documented; original RankNet/LambdaMART runners are outside this package.
